caption: Longer-range missile model phase 5: long ranges at the far tier. Rhodian slingers (team 0, range 180 m / 3600 wu) engage an advancing enemy infantry column (team 1) deployed at an 850-wu opening distance, well beyond the 600-wu DEMOTE_RANGE. Operating in the far tier as flock marks without individual soldier bodies, the slingers open fire across the 850-wu gap, inflicting continuous far-tier missile attrition and suppression before the battle lines ever close to close-tier promotion range.
